experiments.hypothesis: Audit availability and timestamps of historical full-game prices before specifying an edge test
experiments.outcome: Coverage supports closing-line calibration/baseline research from 2010 onward; source quote timestamps are absent, so it cannot support executable decision-time ROI or model promotion.

experiments.hypothesis: One of multiplicative/additive/power de-vig converges significantly closer to the method-specific LOBO closing consensus (paired t-tests, Holm-Bonferroni)
experiments.source: frozen 2022-2024 historical dataset, fingerprint 43f853a44bf93937d85149ca5fd7241b, 162 snapshots, 291586 quotes
experiments.outcome: multiplicative wins both pairwise comparisons (Holm p ~1e-75 vs additive, ~1e-63 vs power); selects the de-vig formula for forward-shadow calibration only. Primary metric (log-loss vs settled outcomes) untestable: no outcomes stored for the historical dataset. Nothing promoted from SHADOW. Identity audit 2026-09-12: 937 provider-id "events" = 825 canonical games (816 regular-season + 9 playoff-weekend listings) + 112 phantom splits from provider id churn. Fixed keying ((home,away) + 7-day kickoff clustering); local re-run: 812 games, 109,985 cells, decision unchanged (multiplicative). 5 regression tests added.

experiments.hypothesis: Pinnacle leads followers (Track A); stale cross-book quotes beat the close via a lagging mechanism (Track B). Preregistered with Amendment A1 (pre-results) replacing Track B's miscalibrated t-test with a directional lag test.
experiments.source: frozen 2022-2024 historical dataset, fingerprint 43f853a44bf93937d85149ca5fd7241b, 162 snapshots, 291586 quotes, 825 canonical games
experiments.outcome: Track A: no book significant after Holm (best FanDuel p=0.102); pooled agree rate 0.526 (+2.6pp, p=0.0125) too small to trade; reverse falsification clean. Track B: lagging fraction 0.348, p=0.995 — no stale-price mechanism; superseded naive t-test would have falsely reported p~2.6e-176. Both tracks: no edge found.
